newsitem.title: USA: Former hurricane rapidly dying in southeast U.S..
newsitem.headline: Former hurricane rapidly dying in southeast U.S..

text.p: Former hurricane Danny was fading quickly as it moved across southeastern states Monday, U.S. meteorologists said.
"You can pretty much consider it rapidly dying," Josh McDowell at the National Hurricane Centre said.
Heavy rains would continue, he added.
Danny was spread over the Alabama-Georgia border area.
The storm's status as a hurricane ended late Saturday after it lashed the U.S. coastline with high winds and torrential rains as it followed a wavering path across the Gulf of Mexico.
